blocks.text: Hex-1-ene aur cyclohexane ka molecular formula aik, C6H12, lekin banawat mukhtalif hai: yeh isomers hain. Dono mein saturated alkane hexane, C6H14, se do hydrogen atoms kam hain: in mein do hydrogen atoms ki kami hai. Yeh kami compound ke unsaturation ke darje ke barabar hai. Har do ghair maujood hydrogen atoms par compound ka aik darja unsaturation hota hai, is liye dono ka IHD 1 hai.

blocks.alt: 1-Hexene ka skeletal formula, chhe carbons ki tedhi zanjeer jis ke daen sire par double bond hai, 1-Hexene (C6H12); aur aik chhe-kona (hexagon), Cyclohexane (C6H12).
blocks.caption: 1-Hexene aur cyclohexane (29.1 ke shuru mein chhapi banawaton ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Index of hydrogen deficiency (IHD)
blocks.text: Unsaturation ka darja (U), ya index of hydrogen deficiency (IHD), compound aur usi tadaad ke carbon atoms wale acyclic alkane ke darmiyan hydrogen atoms ke joron ki tadaad ka farq hai. Har double bond ya ring do hydrogen atoms kam karta aur aik gina jata hai; triple bond do gina jata hai.

Maslan C4H6 mein saturated C4H10 se chaar hydrogen atoms kam hain, is liye is ke unsaturation ke do darje hain (IHD = 2). Hydrocarbon ke liye IHD = (2 x carbons ki tadaad + 2 - hydrogens ki tadaad) / 2.

IHD jaanna banawat ke ishare deta hai, aur yeh sirf formula dekh kar maloom ho sakta hai. Agar IHD 0 ho to compound mein na rings hain na double bonds. Agar 1 ho to compound mein ya aik ring ya aik double bond hai, dono nahi. Agar 2 ho to do rings, do double bonds, har aik ka aik, ya aik triple bond ho sakta hai. IHD yeh chunne mein bhi madad deta hai ke compound ke liye kaun sa tajziyati tareeqa behtar hoga. Hydrocarbons ka IHD Table 29.1 ke data se nikala ja sakta hai.

blocks.caption: Index of hydrogen deficiency (kitab ka Table 29.1)
rows: 2 double bonds ya 2 rings ya 1 double bond aur 1 ring ya 1 triple bond

blocks.prompt: (i) C6H6, (ii) C6H12, (iii) C4H4 ka IHD nikalein, aur har aik ki banawat tajweez karein.
blocks.explanation: (i) (14 - 6)/2 = 4, maslan benzene (aik ring + teen C=C). (ii) (14 - 12)/2 = 1, maslan hex-1-ene ya cyclohexane. (iii) (10 - 4)/2 = 3, maslan but-1-en-3-yne, CH2=CH-C triple bond CH (aik C=C + aik triple bond).

blocks.prompt: Hopane ka formula C30H62 chhapa hai. Is ka IHD nikalein aur batayein ke yeh saturated hai ya nahi.
blocks.explanation: C30H62 ke liye IHD = (62 - 62)/2 = 0: rings ke baghair saturated khuli zanjeer alkane. Note: hopanes darasal C30H52 hain, IHD 5, paanch rings aur koi double bond nahi, is liye yeh bhi saturated hain.

items: IHD = alkane CnH2n+2 ke muqable ghair maujood H ke jore.
Har ring ya C=C 1; triple bond 2.
IHD 0: na rings na multiple bonds.
